notes: Dinosaurs and animals with different powers hunting and fighting each other is the Roblox battlegrounds format, so Action leads and Battlegrounds is the preset - a bounded collision-clean clash space with risky edges, anti-camp spawns and pillars to break combat lock, themed as Jurassic dinosaurs rather than anime fighters. I did not name Simulation or RPG as a second genre even though stats are ground: the answers put the upgrades in a menu spendable anywhere, so the progression has no layout at all and there is no tier-ladder, no purchase gates and no P6 to import. Verticality is a style choice in this genre and the prompt only said a 3d map, so I kept the flat arena and left it on P0. The owner-only admin panel is UI rather than geometry, so nothing in the build expresses it.
